events.clientInsights:
Referred by Marcus Lee (Front Range Tech).
Elena and her now-husband Raj are foodies — they did a full tasting and asked thoughtful questions about every dish.
Family-style storytelling matters to them; we plated with care and got compliments.
Great candidates for an anniversary party next March.
events.dayOfNotes:
Arrived 1:45 PM — venue was ready.
Weather: clear, 62°F — outdoor cocktail hour went ahead.
Final headcount held at 85 (no last-minute changes).
All three entrées plated and out within 18 minutes of first-course clear.
Bride's father visibly emotional during the meal — said it was the best food he'd had at any wedding. Steven personally said hello after dinner.

followUpLog.note: Elena referred by Marcus Lee. Wants a tasting before booking.
Tasting went great. They loved the chimichurri shrimp and the tofu/quinoa option. Booking confirmed.
